text:
jordan: Quick sync on postmortem follow-ups from last night's GPU incident. I want clear owners, short timelines, and recurrence checks for the patterns we saw (quota exhaustion + scheduler packing). Can owners confirm next steps?

maria: I'll list the primary action items I have so far. TL;DR: quota request, scheduler tuning, headroom calc + alert tweaks. I'll own the scheduler tuning PR. Proposed dates inline.

maria: ACTION: open quota request to cloud team (owner: kevin) — target: 2026-04-06

maria: ACTION: scheduler soft-stop tuning (owner: maria) — target PR by 2026-04-03
maria: ACTION: headroom modelling + updated SLOs (owner: lisa) — draft by 2026-04-04
maria: ACTION: add recurring incident set to weekly postmortem radar (owner: samir) — start 2026-04-05

ops-bot: deploy-notify: autoscale-policy v2 applied to prod (sha: a1b2c3). No immediate errors.

samir: @kevin — what's the quota request process and how long does it usually take? we should set a contingency plan if cloud approvals lag.

kevin: I can own the quota request. Expected turnaround historically is 3-7 business days, but I'll try to expedite. Filing the request today. If >72h, fallback is to enable burst-capacity (temp) and reroute low-priority jobs.

kevin: filing note: Summary -> "High sustained GPU allocation from customer workloads during batch window causing scheduler starvation. Request +20 gpus in us-west-2 and an emergency SLA."

lisa: I'll do the headroom modelling. Quick peek at last 48h peak:
```
peak_active_gpus: 92
available_capacity: 96
mean_allocation_window: 4m12s
95p_tail_latency: 320ms
```

lisa: Initial plan: add 10% headroom to autoscale target, tighten early-eviction threshold, and add KV cache warmup window for steady-state jobs.

maria: For scheduler tuning, I'm proposing these knobs to test in canary:
```
- soft_stop_threshold: 0.85 -> 0.88
- preemption_grace: 30s -> 15s
- packing_window_ms: 200 -> 150
```

maria: I'll open a PR with metrics dashboard links and rollback playbook.

samir: I'll take recurring incident tracking and add patterns section to the postmortem doc (spike vs steady leak). Will add owners for each recurring signature.

jordan: Good. Can each owner post a one-line status update in this thread when they open the ticket/PR? I'll close out when all items have an ETA and tracking tickets.

kevin: opened quota ticket C-4821, assigned to cloud-ops. ETA note: 'expedite if production impact'. Posting link: https://tickets.example.com/C-4821

maria: PR opened for scheduler-tuning: https://git.example.com/redwood/runtime/pulls/327 (canary to cluster-a). Running smoke now.

lisa: Headroom model doc: https://docs.example.com/headroom/gpu-model-v1 draft uploaded. Will iterate.

samir: Added recurring pattern section to postmortem doc and scheduled weekly triage (Wednesdays 10:00). Invite sent to ops-sre.

jordan: Perfect. I'll track these into the remediation board and mark owners. Next check-in: 2026-04-04. If anything blocks, drop a short note here. :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup:

maria: :rocket:

ops-bot: reminder: weekly-triage meeting in 48h (calendar invite sent)
